value.answer: Right now the lowest 5-year fixed I can see is about 4.34% if the mortgage is insured (under 20% down), per Ratehub and Wowa. Uninsured, Wowa has the lowest at 4.44%, but its own numbers don't agree, so take that one loosely. The big banks are higher: one of them is at 4.54% on Ratehub's table, Scotiabank is at 4.74%, and the Big 6 average is around 5.14% to 5.17%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September, so they're moving up, not down.
